analysis.detail: Not reachable: since #810 speech-to-text runs in the browser (STT engine "web", kept by openwebui-apply-stt), and BYPASS_PYDUB_PREPROCESSING=true in the container env makes transcribe() skip every pydub call, so neither caller (the transcription endpoint, chat-file processing) hands an upload to ffprobe/ffmpeg; nothing else in Open WebUI runs ffmpeg or pydub on user data. The supported_content_types sentinel alone did not hold: Open WebUI matches it against the client-set multipart Content-Type. The container's root is also an unprivileged host uid now. Before #810: RASC video decoder heap write; ffprobe's stream-info probing decodes video frames. Any approved user can POST arbitrary bytes as audio/* to /api/v1/audio/transcriptions (chat.stt is on, STT engine is local Whisper) or upload them as a chat file; pydub then runs the image's Debian ffprobe/ffmpeg 5.1.9 on them, and ffprobe probes by content and decodes streams of any type. Risk here: any approved user from the internet; memory corruption in a short-lived ffprobe/ffmpeg process that runs as root in a rootful, host-network container. The container runs as root on the VM's host network, so a decoder exploit lands as root there. Action: no fixed Debian 12 package yet; goes away only with an upstream image rebuilt on a fixed base
